info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizruntimedoc-Replace Ecommerce Cart Update-v1-spec
info.description: The Ecommerce Cart Update API facilitates the modification of items within a user's shopping cart. This endpoint allows consumers to update quantities, remove items, or adjust configurations of products already added to the cart. Typical users include eCommerce platforms and applications that require the ability to manage cart contents dynamically. Through this API, businesses can enhance user experience by keeping cart information updated in real-time, ensuring consumers have accurate details during checkout.

put.summary: Update items in the shopping cart.
put.description: This endpoint allows users to modify the contents of their shopping cart. It enables adding, removing, or adjusting the quantities of items within the cart, ensuring users have the flexibility to manage their selections before proceeding to checkout.

requestBody.description: Updates the items in the user's shopping cart. This operation allows the client to modify the cart's contents, including adding new items, removing existing ones, or changing the quantities of items already in the cart.

200.description: The cart update was processed successfully.
